item.title: ‘Girls Like Girls’ Trailer: Hayley Kiyoko Adapts Her Pop Breakthrough Into A Sun-Drenched Coming-Of-Age Romance
item.description: Focus Features released the official trailer for “Girls Like Girls,” the feature adaptation of Hayley Kiyoko’s hit single and best-selling novel of the same name, with the film set to open in theaters nationwide on June 19. Kiyoko directed the coming-of-age romance, translating the personal charge of her original story into a full-length narrative built around first love, first honesty, and the complicated relief of finally seeing yourself clearly. item.title: ‘Erupcja’ Trailer: Charli XCX Makes Her True Acting Debut In Pete Ohs’ Intimate, Warsaw-Set Anti-Romantic Comedy
item.description: For anyone clocking Charli XCX’s hard pivot into acting, it’d be easy to assume her recent film “The Moment” was the beginning of that story. But “Erupcja”—an intimate, Warsaw-set drama from Pete Ohs—actually premiered at the 2025 Toronto International Film Festival first, making it her true big-screen debut, with Charli front and center as Bethany in a romance-derailing, identity-rattling spiral that turns a stranded vacation into something closer to reinvention. item.title: ‘Dear Killer Nannies’ Teaser Trailer: Hulu’s Latin American Drama Follows Pablo Escobar’s Son Growing Up Under Hitmen “Nannies”
item.description: Hulu had introduced its newest Latin American series with a first-look tease that played like a coming-of-age story told from inside a collapsing perimeter. “Dear Killer Nannies” was described as being inspired by Juan Pablo Escobar’s childhood and adolescence, reframing the Pablo Escobar mythology through the kid who had to live in its blast radius—and through the men whose job was to keep the family “safe,” even as they embodied the danger closing in. item.title: New Looks At ‘Spider-Noir’: Jack Huston Plays Sandman Variant In Prime’s 1930s Gumshoe Superhero Series Starring Nicolas Cage
item.description: After playing the supernatural anti-hero Ghost Rider in two feature films, actor Nicolas Cage is returning to the world of superheroes with “Spider-Noir.” Taking on the live-action iteration of his “Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse” character, a private-eye variant of Peter Parker in 1933, who welcomes fights against Nazis. However, some new details about the upcoming streaming series at Prime Video have been revealed alongside new stills, courtesy of Esquire Magazine. Continue reading New Look

item.description: Living legend filmmaker Werner Herzog is synonymous with documentaries thanks to iconic films such as “Grizzly Man,” “My Best Friend,” and “Lessons of Darkness.” His latest doc sees Herzog directing, writing, and narrating “Ghost Elephants,” a new National Geographic Documentary Films project that is heading to select theaters in North America starting on February 27 via Abramorama. item.title: Ana de Armas, Jennifer Connelly Are Circling Apple Spy Series ‘Safe Houses’
item.description: The international safe-house business is built on two promises that can’t peacefully coexist: disappear, and stay protected. That friction is the fuel for “Safe Houses,” and now Ana de Armas and Jennifer Connelly are in negotiations to star in the Apple TV+ series, per Deadline. Apple announced the project back on November 4, 2025, billing it as a fast-paced espionage thriller inspired by Dan Fesperman’s novel and showrun/executive produced by Gideon Raff (“The Spy”).
